title: Innokin Kwik 35K Strawberry Watermelon Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Strawberry Watermelon combines juicy Strawberry sweetness with fresh Watermelon for a smooth, fruit-forward blend. Each puff offers bright, clean flavour that remains consistent. Includes a 2ml prefilled pod and 10ml refill container for the Innokin Kwik 10+2, using mesh-coil and auto-feed technology to keep the coil saturated for longer performance. Explore our entire flavour range of Innokin Kwik 35k Pods . How to Set Up Innokin Kwik 35K Prefilled Pod Step 1 Insert the prefilled pod into the Kwik 10+2 device until it clicks. Step 2 Fit the 10ml refill container securely into the base compartment. Step 3 Inhale on the mouthpiece to vape. Replace the pod pack once both chambers are empty. ✅ You're all set!
